description.description: A high-resolution photograph of the Milky Way galaxy, featuring a dense field of stars in shades of white, blue, and orange. A prominent dark, jagged line of interstellar dust clouds, known as a great rift, bisects the composition diagonally from the bottom left to the top right, with a larger void-like accumulation in the center.
